title: Repeat BMW ownership references
summary: This topic is mostly made up of reviewers noting how many BMWs or 1 Series cars they have owned, with a few clear statements of continued satisfaction and one clear statement of strong disappointment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews link repeat BMW ownership with ongoing satisfaction or praise for build quality.

negative.summary: The negative review says that despite many prior BMWs, this car was the worst the reviewer had owned.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention ownership count, dealer history, or dates without enough sentiment to classify them clearly, and a few examples hint at dissatisfaction but remain assigned as undetermined.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are terse ownership-count or date references that provide limited detail about the actual customer experience.
The cluster mixes repeat-ownership statements, dealer relationship mentions, and isolated date references rather than a single tightly defined product aspect.
